import json, os, statistics, tempfile, time
from wantrain.fault_tolerance.checkpoint import save_shard, sidecar_of, read_sidecar
d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
p = os.path.join(d, "x_ckpt_rank0p0.pt")
blob = os.urandom(1 << 20)
def body(tmp):
    with open(tmp, "wb") as f:
        f.write(blob)
def old(step):
    tmp = p + ".tmp"
    body(tmp)
    os.replace(tmp, p)
    with open(p[:-3] + ".step.json", "w") as f:
        json.dump({"step": step}, f)
def new(step):
    save_shard(p, step, body)
for i in range(20):
    old(i)
    new(i)
o, n = [], []
for i in range(300):
    t = time.perf_counter(); old(i); o.append(time.perf_counter() - t)
    t = time.perf_counter(); new(i); n.append(time.perf_counter() - t)
assert read_sidecar(sidecar_of(p)) == 299, "save_shard did not leave the sidecar naming the last step"
mo, mn = statistics.median(o) * 1e6, statistics.median(n) * 1e6
print(f"OLD_US={mo:.1f}")
print(f"NEW_US={mn:.1f}")
print(f"PROTO_ADDED_US={mn - mo:.1f}")

uv run python -I - <<'PY'
import json, os, re, sys
d = ".factory/runs/m2-p2-wave-label-binding"
marker = os.path.join(d, "h1-seen.log")
stamp = os.path.join(d, "phase-start")
report = ".factory/gates/m2-p2-wave-label-binding.json"
STALL = re.compile(r"fleet cannot progress|fleet stalled")
HEAL = re.compile(r"tests/chaos/test_recovery\.py|tests/multiworker/test_fleet_state_exact\.py")
RUNGS = ("rung:chaos", "rung:multiworker", "rung:full")
ONLY_HEAL = ("rung:chaos", "rung:multiworker")
TEST_RUNGS = ("rung:unit", "rung:integration", "rung:oracle", "rung:identity", "rung:wan")
PINS = ("pinned:chaos-dead-worker-loaded", "pinned:chaos-dead-worker-plain", "pinned:heal-state-exact-loaded")
if not os.path.isfile(stamp):
    print("H1_ERROR=no " + stamp + ": the phase precondition did not run")
    sys.exit(2)


def complete_elsewhere(det):
    m = re.search(r"\nfailures:\n(.*?)\n--- tail ---", det, re.S)
    if not m:
        return False
    lines = m.group(1).split("\n")
    return len(lines) < 40 and any(l.lstrip().startswith("FAILED ") for l in lines)


seen = []
if os.path.isfile(report) and os.path.getmtime(report) > os.path.getmtime(stamp):
    with open(report) as f:
        r = json.load(f)
    # A rung that did not run (skipped behind a failing blocking rung, n/a, not run) has not failed and ran no heal test.
    gates = [(str(g.get("id")), str(g.get("detail", ""))) for g in r.get("gates", []) if g.get("ok") is not True]
    gates = [(gid, det) for gid, det in gates if not gid.startswith("rung:") or det.startswith("fail")]
    deterministic = [gid for gid, det in gates if gid in PINS and re.match(r"0/[0-9]+ passed, then fail ", det) and not STALL.search(det)]
    elsewhere = [gid for gid, _ in gates if gid in TEST_RUNGS]
    for gid, det in gates:
        if gid not in RUNGS + PINS:
            continue
        m, why = STALL.search(det), None
        if m:
            why = m.group(0)
        elif gid in RUNGS and "TIMED OUT" in det:
            why = "timed out"
        elif gid in PINS and re.match(r"[0-9]+/[0-9]+ passed, then hang ", det):
            why = "killed by its timeout"
        elif gid in PINS and re.match(r"[1-9][0-9]*/[0-9]+ passed, then ", det):
            why = "intermittent: earlier repetitions passed on the same tree"
        elif gid in deterministic:
            why = None
        elif gid in RUNGS and deterministic:
            why = None
        elif gid in ONLY_HEAL or HEAL.search(det):
            why = "a heal-file test failed" + (" (mislabeled wave)" if "mislabeled wave" in det else "")
        elif gid == "rung:full" and not complete_elsewhere(det) and not elsewhere:
            why = "rung:full failed and its kept output (600 characters) cannot rule out a heal-file test"
        if why:
            seen.append(f"{gid}: {why} (previous verify, tree {r.get('tree')})")
if seen:
    with open(marker, "a") as f:
        f.write("".join(s + "\n" for s in seen))
if os.path.exists(marker):
    with open(marker) as f:
        lines = f.read().splitlines()
    print("\n".join(lines))
    print(f"H1_SEEN={len(lines)}")
    sys.exit(1)
print("H1_SEEN=0")
PY
